description: This dataset contains measured radio strength and derived spectrum maps for an eighty-by-105-metre urban test area in Nanjing, China. Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics researchers deploy three radiation sources and move a receiver with a spectrum analyser and positioning system through the area. Measurements cover 30 megahertz, 115 megahertz and two gigahertz. Mendeley version 2 provides three CSV measurement tables, three MATLAB tensors and a guide, free under CC BY 4.0. The article specifies one-metre spatial cells; exact calendar dates are not established in the repository metadata. Coverage is limited to the configured site and transmitters. Derived gridded tensors and measured samples should not be treated as independent observations. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating propagation or spectrum-map completion components in wireless-network simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, although channel-model conversion was not tested. No data or guide PDF was downloaded.
